data.current_summary: Get FX spot rates
data.current_description:
Fetches daily FX spot rates between two currencies using official central-bank reference rates.

Path Parameters:
- `base`: Base currency code (e.g., AUD, USD).
- `quote`: Quote currency code (e.g., USD, EUR).

Query Parameters:
- `start_date`: Optional. Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 365 days ago.
- `end_date`: Optional. End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

- `indicators`: Optional. Comma-separated list of technical indicators to compute from the spot-rate series and include in the response. Pass `all` to include every supported indicator. Supported values: `adx_14`, `atr_14`, `bollinger_bands`, `cci_20`, `donchian_20`, `ema_12`, `ema_20`, `ema_200`, `ema_26`, `ema_50`, `macd`, `macd_histogram`, `macd_signal`, `rsi_14`, `sma_20`, `sma_200`, `sma_50`, `stochastic_14_3`, `williams_r_14`, `all`.

Daily reference OHLC:
- On qualifying dates, `data[]` also includes `open`, `high`, `low`, and `close` built from timestamped eligible reference observations. These are `reference_observation_ohlc` bars, not executable-market candles. Rows without at least four observations omit the OHLC fields.

FX source and derivation metadata:
- FX values are official reference rates collected by FXMacroData. USD-quoted pairs are the base series; inverse and cross pairs are derived from those legs when the publisher does not provide the requested pair directly.
- Responses include `pair_metadata` and row-level `data[].source` with `direct_available`, `inverse_available`, `is_derived`, `derived_from_inverse`, `derived_from_cross`, `derived_from_source_legs`, `derivation_method`, `anchor_currency`, `source_pair`, `source_legs`, and `pair_consistency_check`.
- Upstream FX source priority is BIS XRU daily USD exchange rates where available, then official national-bank daily sources, explicitly labelled EUR/CAD-derived daily crosses, official USD pegs, BIS monthly averages expanded to business days, IMF IFS monthly rates, and World Bank annual rates. Lower-frequency expansions are labelled with `source_frequency` and `derivation_method`; they are not presented as true daily fixings.
- `data[].observation_datetime` is the UTC midnight timestamp for the FX reference date. It is an observation-date marker, not a publication timestamp.
- XAU/USD and USD/XAU use the stored gold series: the National Bank of Ukraine official accounting price of gold divided by the NBU official UAH/USD rate for the same official rate date (Narodowy Bank Polski gold only for dates the NBU did not supply). Source: National Bank of Ukraine (https://bank.gov.ua/en/open-data). No publication clock or LBMA auction price is asserted. Weekday-label coverage is included.

Retrieves daily FX spot rates between two currencies using official central-bank reference rates. Returns time-series data with OHLC bars (where available), technical indicators (optional), and comprehensive source/derivation metadata.

**Inputs:**

- `start_date`, `end_date`: Optional date range (YYYY-MM-DD format; defaults to last 365 days)

**Outputs:**

**Data Sources:** BIS XRU daily rates (priority), official national-bank sources, EUR/CAD crosses, USD pegs, BIS monthly averages, IMF IFS, World Bank annual rates. XAU/USD uses NBU gold accounting price divided by NBU UAH/USD rate.

data.current_summary: Get FX spot rates
data.current_description:
Fetches daily FX spot rates between two currencies using official central-bank reference rates.

Path Parameters:
- `base`: Base currency code (e.g., AUD, USD).
- `quote`: Quote currency code (e.g., USD, EUR).

Query Parameters:
- `start_date`: Optional. Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 365 days ago.
- `end_date`: Optional. End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

- `indicators`: Optional. Comma-separated list of technical indicators to compute from the spot-rate series and include in the response. Pass `all` to include every supported indicator. Supported values: `adx_14`, `atr_14`, `bollinger_bands`, `cci_20`, `donchian_20`, `ema_12`, `ema_20`, `ema_200`, `ema_26`, `ema_50`, `macd`, `macd_histogram`, `macd_signal`, `rsi_14`, `sma_20`, `sma_200`, `sma_50`, `stochastic_14_3`, `williams_r_14`, `all`.

Daily reference OHLC:
- On qualifying dates, `data[]` also includes `open`, `high`, `low`, and `close` built from timestamped eligible reference observations. These are `reference_observation_ohlc` bars, not executable-market candles. Rows without at least four observations omit the OHLC fields.

FX source and derivation metadata:
- FX values are official reference rates collected by FXMacroData. USD-quoted pairs are the base series; inverse and cross pairs are derived from those legs when the publisher does not provide the requested pair directly.
- Responses include `pair_metadata` and row-level `data[].source` with `direct_available`, `inverse_available`, `is_derived`, `derived_from_inverse`, `derived_from_cross`, `derived_from_source_legs`, `derivation_method`, `anchor_currency`, `source_pair`, `source_legs`, and `pair_consistency_check`.
- Upstream FX source priority is BIS XRU daily USD exchange rates where available, then official national-bank daily sources, explicitly labelled EUR/CAD-derived daily crosses, official USD pegs, BIS monthly averages expanded to business days, IMF IFS monthly rates, and World Bank annual rates. Lower-frequency expansions are labelled with `source_frequency` and `derivation_method`; they are not presented as true daily fixings.
- `data[].observation_datetime` is the UTC midnight timestamp for the FX reference date. It is an observation-date marker, not a publication timestamp.
- XAU/USD and USD/XAU use the stored gold series: the National Bank of Ukraine official accounting price of gold divided by the NBU official UAH/USD rate for the same official rate date (Narodowy Bank Polski gold only for dates the NBU did not supply). Source: National Bank of Ukraine (https://bank.gov.ua/en/open-data). No publication clock or LBMA auction price is asserted. Weekday-label coverage is included.

Retrieves daily FX spot rates between two currencies using official central-bank reference rates. Returns time-series data with OHLC bars (where available), technical indicators (optional), and comprehensive source/derivation metadata.

**Inputs:**
- `base` and `quote`: Currency codes (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD)
- `start_date`, `end_date`: Optional date range (YYYY-MM-DD format; defaults to last 365 days)
- `indicators`: Optional comma-separated technical indicators (adx_14, atr_14, bollinger_bands, cci_20, donchian_20, ema_*, macd, rsi_14, sma_*, stochastic_14_3, williams_r_14, or 'all')

**Outputs:**
- Time-series array with daily observations including rate, OHLC (when available), and computed indicators
- `pair_metadata`: Source availability and derivation information
- Row-level `source` metadata: direct/inverse/cross derivation flags, derivation method, source legs, and consistency checks
- `observation_datetime`: UTC midnight timestamp for each reference date

**Data Sources:** BIS XRU daily rates (priority), official national-bank sources, EUR/CAD crosses, USD pegs, BIS monthly averages, IMF IFS, World Bank annual rates. XAU/USD uses NBU gold accounting price divided by NBU UAH/USD rate.
